signal: completed close>SMA200, Wilder RSI2<=20, return3<0; raw split-adjusted price, no dividend backfill

entry_variants.pullback: next session buy limit at signal close; if opens lower fill at open; otherwise low must trade strictly below limit
entry_variants.breakout: next session stop-limit above signal high, entry capped at signal close+.5ATR; gap open above cap is unfilled

same_day: for intraday fill, entry-day lows can stop immediately; no entry-day upside exits counted, conservative ordering; close auction no entry-day barriers
exit: stop/target +-2 signal ATR; time exit20 sessions after entry; gap at open; both touched same day stop first
primary: net positive realized return with expectancy and loss, not win rate alone
secondary: actual fill to 10th subsequent close net return>=10%; distinct no-barrier label
nonoverlap: within each variant, no new signal while position active
limitations: all periods previously potentially inspected; no untouched audit
single currently selected survivor; no PIT all-market universe
no historical intraday orderbook; all daily variants are execution proxies
no hyperparameter search; no causal news or calibrated current probability
default_decision: no certified maximum win probability; select transparent conditional execution only
